Paper Title / Journal: LS-SSDD-v1.0: A Deep Learning Benchmark Dataset for Ship Detection in Large-Scale SAR (MDPI RS)
Core Methodology: Faster R-CNN, YOLOv3, SSD, RetinaNet benchmarks on 15 large scenes
Reported Metrics: Faster R-CNN: 71.6% mAP50; YOLOv3: 69.4% mAP50, 75.2% P, 64.1% R
Project Relevance & Comparative Finding: Foundational dataset benchmark; our YOLOv8s achieves 69.0% mAP50 with superior precision (80.7%)

Paper Title / Journal: OpenSAR: A High-Resolution SAR Ship Detection Benchmark (IEEE TGRS)
Core Methodology: Single-Look Complex radar chip classification and bounding box regression
Reported Metrics: Baseline CNN: 40-55% mAP across speckle-heavy slant range
Project Relevance & Comparative Finding: Origin of our OpenSAR YOLO11s experiments; confirmed severe domain collapse on GRD data

Paper Title / Journal: AIR-SARShip-1.0: High-Resolution SAR Ship Dataset (J. Radars)
Core Methodology: Oriented bounding box (OBB) detection with rotated anchors
Project Relevance & Comparative Finding: Highlights benefit of fine resolution; informs future rotated bounding box enhancement

Paper Title / Journal: Ship Detection and Tracking by Fusion of SAR and AIS (Remote Sensing)
Core Methodology: Linear spatial buffer matching (+-30 min, 5 km radius)
Reported Metrics: Matching accuracy 84.2% in open ocean, 61.5% coastal
Project Relevance & Comparative Finding: Demonstrates failure of rigid spatial gates; proves necessity of our kinematic uncertainty budget

Paper Title / Journal: Speed Loss of Modern Ships in Rough Seas (J. Marine Sci. Tech.)
Core Methodology: Empirical hydrodynamic formula relating wave height and heading to speed loss
Reported Metrics: Accurate within 0.5 kn for container vessels
Project Relevance & Comparative Finding: Implemented in our weather routing engine alongside deep-learning TFT surrogate
